name: page-capture-delivery
goal: Persist revision-bound page screenshots through Git history and show one scalar per overview metric before merging main.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Prior handoff 6b6bea90 recorded 46 timings but no screenshots in its focused checkpoint; captures lived only outside Git. The overview reads full records only, so both sides are blank. The multi-profile table was introduced by the previous measurement change and is too busy for Overview.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing loop CLI tests prove logs and benchmark retention, not screenshot files or Git rebuilds. Existing browser measurements tests explicitly expect a table. Extend these standard cases to retain and validate screenshot bytes, read focused media on correct revisions, reject missing/wrong-unit data, and require four scalar overview rows at three sizes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed standard tests at 8640d15b. Isolated red proof 12123b56 reproduced screenshot retention and scalar overview failures; root recorder failure was the named assertion.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Retain decoded, hash-sealed captures with focused proofs before cleanup; rebuild exact-unit/revision media in history without granting full verdicts. Overview selects one latency and matching-workload memory, preserving details separately. Existing standard tests guard retention, missing bytes and scalar rows.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Focused records retain sealed pixels and source-bound metadata before cleanup. Local, desktop and hosted readers resolve them without granting full verification. Standard recorder and overview tests pass locally; instructions now require complete durable screenshot delivery.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable proof 0a198bd9 passed the unchanged corpus at 5d87bd54, retaining 144 screenshots and 42 measured page observations. Git rebuild resolved all captures; desktop and hosted readers opened the three viewport images and refused wrong hashes.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: In an isolated 5d87bd54 snapshot, restored the old recorder and verbose overview from 8ac6231a: standard tests failed for missing image bytes and Latency rows. Restored both repaired files and the same 6 CLI plus 11 overview tests passed.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: At 4843a73bf2d22b8c50d040687967f565de8a3119, record 0d3daecbc0adc57d1a9adf972e24b8cc7c07f1f741598220736700bdcebfae99 passes unchanged tests and fixtures: 22 overview/selection tests, all 50 Explorer browser cases, three measurement previews, four Settings cases, five design review cases and 26 workload cases. The record retains 1020 observations, including 12 schema-validated process readings. Root 891 unit and 230 E2E tests, corrected package/isolation checks, Reports 615 tests, Desktop 932 tests with complete 201-case browser coverage via affected reruns, Hub 477 tests and 28 browser cases, and remaining workspace stages pass. Historical failed runs remain recorded; this is focused proof, not a full verification verdict.
